- The left lit window above awning now reveals additional orderly shelves of medicines and dried herbs, suggesting the whole building is a tiny pharmacy, without enlarging window or changing facade.
- Replace the empty crate beside workbench with neatly bundled paper medicine packets and a few ingredient jars; a small herb planter nearby with recognizable rosemary/lavender leaf shapes.
Keep additions clustered in pharmacy area; courtyard stone paving, right bench and distant neighborhood stay restful and unchanged, no bottles scattered in street, no giant factory, no fluorescent pharmacy signage/cross symbol, no glowing rainbow potions. Everyday Japanese coastal architecture mixed with cozy small apothecary details; faint mint liquid is only magical hint besides cat. Warm amber near table and muted shadows elsewhere. Same soft pixel clusters as source, no smooth cartoon lines or hyper-crisp outlines.
No readable writing, UI, border, watermark, extra creatures, additional shop buildings or composition change.
